profile.reading:
Per NTT's own Global Data Centers facility page, this building, NTT Hillsboro HI1, is located at 4050 NE Evergreen Rd, Hillsboro, OR 97124. The operator publishes 138,000 square feet of data floor space and 36 megawatts of critical IT load for this specific building, and states it is Cleaner Air Oregon certified; no opening year is stated on the page. NTT's own newsroom describes the broader Hillsboro campus as a 126-megawatt, more than 1-million-square-foot development across 47 acres in Washington County, meaning HI1 represents only a fraction of the planned campus capacity, with additional buildings under development.

Hillsboro sits at the center of Oregon's "Silicon Forest," a data center and semiconductor corridor that has drawn hyperscale and colocation investment for years under the state's enterprise-zone property tax abatement program, which multiple operators in this registry, including RagingWire's corporate sibling Digital Realty, have used for other Hillsboro-area facilities. Washington County's enterprise zone abatements have made Hillsboro one of the most tax-advantaged data center submarkets on the West Coast, a factor cited by multiple operators, including NTT, in continuing to expand their Hillsboro campuses even as some Oregon communities debate the tradeoffs of large industrial tax exemptions against strained local services.

NTT's US Global Data Centers footprint spans seven named campuses in total: Ashburn, Virginia at 224 megawatts; Chicago, Illinois at more than 200 megawatts; Dallas, Texas at 160 megawatts; Hillsboro, Oregon at 126 megawatts; Phoenix, Arizona at 240 megawatts; and a combined Sacramento/Santa Clara, California figure of 68 megawatts, totaling roughly 1,118 megawatts or more of disclosed US capacity, per the operator's own locations page. The US business operates under the NTT DATA Global Data Centers Americas name, the successor brand to RagingWire Data Centers, now under Japan's NTT DATA Group and parent Nippon Telegraph and Telephone Corporation, a Tokyo Stock Exchange-listed company not subject to SEC 10-K filing requirements.

[batch narration moved out of reading 2026-09-02] This facility is attributed in the registry to NTT, part of Nippon Telegraph and Telephone Corporation, one of the largest telecommunications and IT services groups in the world, headquartered in Tokyo, Japan. NTT operates a global data center business, NTT Global Data Centers, under NTT DATA, Inc. The operators own about us page, fetched this session, states NTT DATA is a top 10 global IT services provider with about 30 billion dollars in annual revenue, operations across 33 countries, and about 3 billion dollars in annual research and development investment, headquartered at the Toyosu Center Building, 3-3-3 Toyosu, Koto-ku, Tokyo 135-6033, Japan, though these figures describe the wider NTT DATA organization rather than the data center division specifically, and no data center division formation or acquisition date was found on the pages fetched this session. A previously confirmed, specific data center acquisition remains NTT Communications purchase of an 86.7 percent stake in e-shelter, described as Germany top data center operator, completed around June 23, 2015, though that acquisition is not directly connected to this United States facility. This session reached the operators own services.global.ntt data center locations pages directly and successfully. An earlier sessions attempts to reach the ragingwire.com domain had failed and found no corresponding Wikipedia article, a negative finding this session did not need to repeat. No dedicated operator facility page or Oregon or Hillsboro area overview page was found this session, a guessed overview URL returned 404. Reverse geocoding this rows own stored coordinates through a third party service returned a single, high confidence candidate, 25300 Evergreen Rd, Hillsboro, OR 97124, at 0.9 confidence and a tight 0.012 distance. However, this rows sibling entry sharing the same generic registry name was throttled on repeated attempts and never returned a comparable result to check for cross row consistency, and no operator page or aggregator listing was found to independently confirm this specific street. Consistent with this projects standard that a geocoding services own confidence score is not itself corroboration, this session records the candidate but does not apply it as this rows address.

Oregon has 133 mapped data center facilities, but only eight publish power figures totaling 156.6 megawatts of IT load, placing this campus outside the ranked set.

The operator is NTT, a major global telecommunications and IT services group, but no dedicated page for this facility or its specifications was found. The address listed is in Hillsboro, Oregon, in Washington County, an area with semiconductor and technology infrastructure, though the exact street location has not been independently corroborated.

Without published power capacity, racks, or certifications, this facility cannot be assessed for its relevance to AI infrastructure scaling.
